lucy (Finance): FYI - Customer Vertex Labs invoice INV-4499 failed with 'insufficient_funds' and 'card_not_supported' alternately. Autopay retried twice. Any ideas?

omar (Billing): Do we have the raw gateway errors? Could be a dual response from network switch.

lucy (Finance): Gateway: {"primary_error":"insufficient_funds", "secondary":"card_not_supported", "txn":"tx_aa7f1"}

ben (Payments Ops): That's usually issuer-level decline plus fallback routing. Try a single-use card update link and a manual retry. If they decline again, offer wire/ACH.

tess (Support): Customer says they switched merchant-level restrictions last week. They can try a different card but asked about timing.

eli (CS): They need onboarding to start Tue. If they can't update quickly, they'd prefer ACH. Do we have ACH instructions for EU customers?

omar (Billing): We have SEPA templates. Finance, can you send SEPA details + invoice with tax split? Mark invoice: hold_autopay: true until payment confirmed.

lucy (Finance): Will prepare SEPA pdf and upload secure link. Also logging ticket PAY-9001 to review BIN/routing pattern.

ben (Payments Ops): I'll capture the gateway logs, save acquirer id and BIN ranges, and propose routing exceptions. For now, CS please share single-use link when ready and I'll attempt manual capture if they update card.

eli (CS): Ok I'll push link and ask for ACH. Will confirm back when they respond. :thumbsup:
